item.description:
Fixes a crash when a Breathe session started. If Breathe closed the app the first time you tried it with headphones, this is the cure — it's worth a second try.

The break screen also grew into itself: it fades in gently, the wave is now the app's own mark writ large — same seven bars, same colours as the one that ripples while you dictate — and the background breathes with you.
